Graphics-card setup

GInfer, the program that runs your models, measures your graphics cards and saves the results as a hardware profile. Reusing these results helps models load and switch faster. Run this setup before using your models, and measure again if your hardware changes.

Graphics-card settings ready

Technical details
Your graphics-card settings are ready. Each model still needs a memory check before starting; these settings do not guarantee that every model or conversation length will fit.

Select your graphics cards below. GChat will check that the installed GInfer program can measure them.

Choose graphics cards
GInfer supports groups of 1, 2 or 4 matching graphics cards. Each combination needs its own saved settings. Select the cards you want to use together, then select Measure graphics cards. If you have one card, select it below.

Graphics card 1: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
Graphics card 2: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
Select 1, 2 or 4 matching cards to continue. Cards of a different type cannot be combined.
Measure again
